The **36 → 72 corridor is real**, but it is not a single straight Mesopotamia → 72 lineage. It is a **branch-and-join architecture**.

## 1. Mesopotamian 36 → Egyptian 36: direct lineage fails

The Egyptian 36-decans system is earlier. Middle Kingdom diagonal star tables are attested around 2000 BCE; their 36 decans are sequential star groups associated with ten-day periods. citeturn954115search1turn388782search0

The Mesopotamian *Three Stars Each* architecture is later and structurally different:

\[
\boxed{
12_{\rm months}\times3_{\rm celestial\ paths}=36
}
\]

with one star in each of the paths of Enlil, Anu and Ea for each month. It is not a continuous sequence of 36 ten-day decans. citeturn954115s
